Definition: Tsadok, the name of eight or nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zadok = "righteous"; 1) the high priest, son of Ahitub of the house of Eleazar the son of Aaron, and 11th in descent from Aaron; joined David after Saul's death and supported him against Absalom and Adonijah; anointed Solomon as king; 2) a priest, son of Meraioth, father of Meshullam of the house of Ahitub; apparently a nephew of 1; 3) father of Jerusha, the wife of king Uzziah and mother of king Jotham of Judah; 4) son of Baana and repairer of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 5) son of Immer and repairer of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 6) a leader of the people in the time of Nehemiah; 7) a scribe appointed by Nehemiah as one of the treasurers over the storehouse; 8) a valiant warrior of the tribe of Benjamin who joined David at Hebron. Same as 1?
